_about: Structured description of the REV Hub Serial Protocol (RHSP / DEKA interface) as implemented by the rhsp Python package. Generated by docs/generate_protocol_json.py from src/rhsp/internal/messages.py. Field structure is introspected from the live classes; semantics/sequencing are curated.

protocol.name: REV Hub Serial Protocol (RHSP)
protocol.transaction_model: half-duplex request/response, one outstanding at a time

link_layer.port_discovery: USB hwid SER= field; hub serial numbers start with 'D'.
link_layer.topology: Controller <-> parent hub over USB (UART0). Child hubs connect to the parent over RS485 (UART1) and are reached via the parent's packet forwarding. Same protocol on both legs. Source: DuckLynx info/RHSP.md.

framing.max_payload_size_note: This Python package caps payload at PAYLOAD_MAX_SIZE=128; REV librhsp allows up to 512. Size receive buffers for 512.

header_fields.name: packetLength
header_fields.description: Total packet size in bytes incl. frame, header, payload, checksum.

header_fields.name: source
header_fields.description: Always 0x00 for the controller; the hub's address on a reply.

header_fields.name: messageNumber
header_fields.description: Per spec must be >= 1 (never 0); starts at 1, wraps to 1 on overflow.

header_fields.name: referenceNumber
header_fields.description: On a response, echoes the request's messageNumber.

checksum.algorithm: 8-bit sum of all bytes from frame start through end of payload, mod 256
checksum.on_bad_checksum: Hub sends no reply and does not reset the keep-alive timeout.

constants.response_id_rule: A typed response id = response_bit | request_id (e.g. GetADC 0x1007 -> 0x9007). ACK/NACK keep their own ids.

ClosedLoopMode._note: Used as the 'mode' selector for Set/GetMotorPIDCoefficients.

I2CSpeedCode._note: Values per REV firmware; confirm against librhsp.

NackCode.18: No GPIO pins configured for output
NackCode.28: No GPIO pins configured for input
NackCode.30: Servo not fully configured before enabled
NackCode.31: Battery voltage too low to run servo
NackCode.50: Motor not fully configured for mode before enabled
NackCode.51: Command not valid for selected motor mode
NackCode.52: Battery voltage too low to run motor

keep_alive_note: Hub enters fail-safe (outputs disabled) after 2500 ms with no valid packet. Any valid packet resets the timeout, even one that is NACK'd; bad-checksum/no-magic packets do not. Source: DuckLynx info/RHSP.md.

firmware_command_map_divergence._note: Function ids 0x00-0x30 agree across implementations. From 0x31 onward the stock firmware/librhsp map differs from this package's messages.py. Resolve DEKA ids dynamically via QueryInterface and validate high ids against the target hub.

commands.name: GetBulkInputData
commands.notes: Single-transaction snapshot of all digital/analog/motor/servo/I2C state. Preferred over many individual gets.

payload.name: values
payload.description: Bitmask, one bit per DIO pin (8 pins).

commands.name: SetMotorChannelMode
commands.notes: Must be set before enabling a motor. Mode selects the control loop (power/velocity/position/current).

commands.name: I2CBlockReadConfig
commands.notes: Configures the hub to autonomously poll an I2C register block; cached results are then read cheaply via GetBulkI2CData. NOTE: the Python helper has a bug (writes to the message object, not its payload).

payload.name: clearStatus
payload.description: Nonzero clears the latched status after reading.

commands.name: KeepAlive
commands.notes: Resets the hub watchdog. Must be sent at least every ~2.5 s or the hub enters fail-safe and disables all outputs.

commands.name: FailSafe
commands.notes: Immediately puts the hub in fail-safe (outputs disabled).

commands.name: SetNewModuleAddress
commands.notes: Changes the module's address; all subsequent commands must target the new address.

commands.name: QueryInterface
commands.notes: Returns the base packetID and command count for a named interface. Send interfaceName='DEKA' to learn the runtime base id of the I/O command block (0x1000 in this firmware).

commands.name: Discovery
commands.notes: Broadcast to address 255. The hub and any daisy-chained child modules each emit a Discovery_RSP; collect replies until the input buffer drains. Must be the first transaction.

payload.name: mototonicTime
payload.description: Monotonic timestamp (field name misspelled in source).

payload.name: inputValues
payload.description: Bitmask, one bit per DIO pin.

payload.name: adcValue
payload.description: Reading; engineering units are mA/mV depending on channel (see ADCChannel).

payload.name: parent
payload.description: Parent module address; 0/255 for a USB-attached parent hub.

session_bringup.description: Required order to go from no connection to a usable module.
steps: Enumerate serial ports (USB serial number starts with 'D').
Open the port at 460800 8N1, no flow control.
Send Discovery (broadcast, dest=255); build a Module per Discovery_RSP.
Optionally QueryInterface('DEKA') to confirm the I/O command base id.
Start a KeepAlive heartbeat (>= every ~2.5 s) for as long as outputs are active.

module_init_periphs.description: What Module.init_periphs() does, per hardware block.
steps: For each of 4 motor channels: SetMotorChannelMode(channel, mode=0, floatAtZero=1) then SetMotorConstantPower(channel, 0).
Create 4 I2C channel handles (no traffic until a device is added).
For each of 6 servo channels: SetServoConfiguration(channel, framePeriod=20000).

motor_open_loop_power.description: Drive a motor with constant power (test_motor.py).

motor_closed_loop_velocity.description: Run a motor at a target velocity (test_motor_velocity.py).
steps: Read velocity via GetBulkMotorData (motorNVelocity is 16-bit signed)

i2c_color_sensor_v2_apds9960.description: Bring up the REV color sensor (color.py ColorSensor).
steps: writeByte(COMMAND_BIT|ENABLE_REG); writeByte(0x07)  # power on + ADC + wait

i2c_distance_sensor_vl53l0x.description: Bring up the REV 2m distance sensor (distance.py).
steps: initialize(): data-init register sequence, read stop_variable, set signal-rate limit,
load SPAD config, load default tuning register map, set GPIO interrupt,
readRangeContinuousMillimeters(): poll RESULT_INTERRUPT_STATUS until ready, read range, clear interrupt.
Read cached block via GetBulkI2CData (imuBlock field) or IMUBlockReadQuery
